metadata.description: 37 Claude Code skills across 10 personas for France Schengen visa applications (EN + zh-CN bilingual)

plugins.name: trip-planner
plugins.description: Plans a France Schengen trip end-to-end — destinations, dates, visa type, and a backwards timeline from your travel date so nothing slips.

plugins.name: document-engineer
plugins.description: Builds the visa document pack — photo, insurance, cover letter, accommodation proof, translations, apostille — and catches small-rule slips that cause refusals.

plugins.name: accountant
plugins.description: Prepares the visa financial pack — employment letter, bank statements, cost estimate, and a financial-evidence checklist that meets consulate thresholds.

plugins.name: minor-specialist
plugins.description: Handles Schengen visa applications for children under 18 — parent consent, birth certificate, school letter, and the extra parent documents consulates require.

plugins.name: sponsor-specialist
plugins.description: Guides Schengen visa applications where someone else (family, employer, host) sponsors the trip — invitation letter, proof of relationship, and sponsor financials.

plugins.name: forms-specialist
plugins.description: Fills the France-Visas online form and the TLScontact follow-up form correctly the first time, including the group-application flow for families travelling together.

plugins.name: appointment-coordinator
plugins.description: Finds and books a TLScontact appointment slot, then prepares you for the visit — what to bring, what to expect, and how to behave on appointment day.

plugins.name: application-auditor
plugins.description: Reviews a completed visa application before submission — finds gaps, inconsistencies, and refusal risks, and runs a mock consular interview so you're ready.

plugins.name: recovery-advisor
plugins.description: Helps after the application is submitted — track status, appeal a refusal, and handle the first-trip extras (entry stamps, 90/180 rule, what to carry).

plugins.name: meta-utility
plugins.description: Maintenance helpers for the Schengen skills themselves — record learnings, view the audit log, and upgrade the vstack skill collection.
